description: Use when the same underlying research or dataset needs to ship as multiple audience-specific documents from one source of truth — e.g. "write this for investors, for students, and for the general reader," "make an entrepreneur version and an internal-memo version of this report," "same data, different audiences," "multi-tier report," "persona-routed report," or "one dataset, five write-ups." Produces N parallel documents that share a locked fact layer (same companies, same numbers, same section skeleton) but diverge in voice, framing, and one persona-specific section. Do NOT use for a single audience/single document — write it directly. Do NOT use for the newsletter 3-tier pipeline (Non-Tech/Tech Dept/AI Team) — that's kyle-os:newsletter.
